verdict.rationale: Viam's own marketing claims cover each part of the story: OTA updates for software and ML models, canary testing, and rollbacks, plus updating machines without SSH and staging and rolling back models. These are brief marketing-level statements rather than detailed docs on how rollouts are staged or how rollback is triggered. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on staged or percentage rollout mechanics for software and modules, documented rollback procedure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can deploy software updates over-the-air to robots with staged rollouts and rollback

citations.quote: OTA updates for software and ML models; Canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning
